exposure.needed: whether the operator filters cert-manager log lines with grep or similar text matching on the old log format

original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to some log lines, so those lines have a new format and log filters that use grep or similar tools may stop matching.

decision.reason: [ev-95c9a508db46] says only that some log lines changed format because structured logging information was added, and it warns users who filter logs with grep or similar tools. Whether an environment does that depends on the operator's external log tooling. No static input carries that: not Helm values, manifests, flags or versions. So an undecidable exposure that asks whether the operator text-matches cert-manager log lines on the old format fits the evidence exactly. A predicate would be either too broad (every install emits logs) or made up.
